purpose: Correct the v20 high-band audit to the paper confirmatory 2-D radial spectrum definition and test the existing structural low/mid projection on the 16 DSCP coefficient maps.
claim_scope: post-hoc train-only method diagnostic; not independent promotion evidence
truth_scope: 24 train/final_train_confirm records already consumed by v19; validation and test_id remain sealed
candidate: frozen v18 B_data_hinge best checkpoint, unchanged weights

arms.coefficient_radial_guard: apply project_low_mid_increment to the 16 coefficient maps before rank-16 temporal materialization

metric: spatial_spectrum_relative_l2 from confirmatory_metrics.py: normalized 2-D radial rfft2 masks low <=1/3, middle (1/3,2/3], high >2/3

readout.viable: Guarded radial-high nonworse 24/24 within 1e-6, guarded mean radial-high gain >= -1e-6, aggregate mean gain no more than 0.005 below raw, aggregate nonworse within 1% at least 23/24, and worst aggregate harm >= -0.02.
